# roastmarket

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

German online shop for coffee and espresso beans, coffee machines including fully automatic and portafilter machines, grinders and coffee accessories. Its shipping page lists Germany among 23 delivery countries, usually delivered within 1 to 2 working days.

## Shopping notes

Coffee and accessories ship for 4.90 EUR under a 49 EUR order value and free above it. Machines and freight goods have separate rates.
